change: Diagnostic profiler invokes search_pcb_models through explicit repeatable --search-strategy options. Each strategy starts from baseline settings; + combines overrides in one attempt. Default board commands remain unchanged.
reporting: Per-attempt statuses, counter receipts and complete ordered fallback events; search_total is the entire portfolio including screening. Existing model_total remains selected construction only. Search timing explicitly includes all strategies, screening and diagnostic output. Unscoped per-model thermal/selection traces are rejected; multi-strategy catalog summaries are not misrepresented as one catalog.

tests.parser_cases: Ordered strategies and combined overrides; reject unknown/empty/duplicate components, conflicting rankings, semantically duplicate combinations, missing rotation prerequisites and ambiguous trace scopes.

carrier_natural_failure_retention.recipe: powersom face recipe at 163x151 with release pilot pins; --search-strategy estimator-first --search-strategy extent

combined_repeat.recipe: release-pinned powersom face recipe at 163x151; --search-strategy extent+estimator-first --runs 2
combined_repeat.both_runs: baseline retained after naturally failing combined challenger

limits: This is diagnostic workflow integration, not publication or complete board qualification. The original removed vertical-compaction experiment was not reintroduced. No smaller accepted carrier, default production strategy change, full-suite run or matched Python timing comparison. Natural failure retention and repeatability are verified; performance gains are not claimed.
